title: Ollama (LLM)
description: A model served by Ollama, on this machine or your network, through gohort's Ollama client: its own API, which keeps thinking control and the context window.
setup_notes: Run ollama serve and pull the model (ollama pull <model>). gohort provides one, named ollama and listed as Ollama; another, at another address, is added from here. Choose it under Admin > LLMs > Worker LLM (or Lead LLM), where its address is set and the tier names its model; Test connection there says what is at the address and makes one short real chat. Its parallel requests are capped under Local Model Scheduler. Native tool calling is a toggle on the tier, for a model that supports it.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the LLM settings list it by this name.

config.name: base_url
config.label: Server address
config.detail: On this machine or its network. Its default is the server's own; a server elsewhere needs its address.
